description: Bike Direct Network is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Infrastructure and Transport. BikeDirect is a strategic network of bicycle routes across the Adelaide metropolitan region in a variety of formats. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Infrastructure and Transport. Its tags are bikes, health, recreation, routes, safety. It offers 5 resource(s) in geojson, html, kml, map viewer, shp. The portal shows 2020-02-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
